title: Gumdrop
body:
Description

The Gumdrop is a holiday resource that spawns randomly across Finlay. It appears in two variants: Red Gumdrop and Green Gumdrop. Both variants function almost identically and differ only in appearance and price. Gumdrops are typically associated with Christmas-related content and are obtainable exclusively during seasonal events. When processed, Gumdrops do not produce standard cash and instead reward snowflake currency only.

Gumdrops are currently unobtainable naturally, and may only be obtained by trading with players, or, the next Christmas event if they are re-added.

Variants





Red Gumdrop

The 'Red Gumdrop' is a red-colored variant of the Gumdrop resource. It spawns randomly on Finlay Island and shares identical properties with the Green Gumdrop.





Green Gumdrop

The 'Green Gumdrop' is a green-colored variant of the Gumdrop resource. It spawns under the same conditions and has no mechanical differences, only visual compared to the Red Gumdrop.
